metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and skills from Hikmah Labs

plugins.name: general-translation
plugins.description: Set up or extend General Translation (gt-next) i18n in a Next.js App Router app — covers GTProvider placement, <T>/<Var>/t() patterns, ESLint + smoke-test enforcement, locale switching, RTL, and the full app-translation migration workflow.

plugins.name: stripe-convex-webhook
plugins.description: Set up (or migrate to) a Stripe webhook hosted on a Convex HTTP endpoint instead of a Next.js API route — Convex httpAction pattern with constructEventAsync, internal-mutation conversion, .convex.site URL discovery, env-var audit, and Stripe Dashboard setup. Removes the need for `stripe listen` in dev.

plugins.name: draft-plugin
plugins.description: Scaffold a new plugin into the local hikmahlabs/plugins marketplace based on a pattern from the current session — 9-step flow with confirmation prompts, file templates for plugin.json/README/SKILL/references, and the marketplace.json + root README updates (including the U+2011 non-breaking-hyphen rule). Writes files only; never touches git.

plugins.name: dev-lifecycle
plugins.description: End-to-end development lifecycle commands — idea → classified GitHub issue on a Projects board → worktree → PR → squash-merge. Ships /intake, /triage, /start, /preflight, /open-pr (config-driven via a per-repo .github/dev-workflow.yml). Auto-flags sensitive diffs for human review; reviews stay local; merging auto-deploys. Pairs with the hikmahlabs/project-template repo for the GitHub layer + bootstrap script.
